text_block_list.text:
Today, the girls from Phalaenopsis's club 
were visiting, 
so we had arranged to show them around the 
town 
and the Academy.

text_block_list.name: Club Girls
text_block_list.text:
It's been so long! 
Phaleno! Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, your spirit was always exceptional 
even at the club. 
And you've grown all the more gallant, 
too.
choice_data_list: We'll be showing you around today!
We'll be showing you around today!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
...Actually! If possible, before that... 
we want you to see the fruits of our daily 
training, 
Phaleno!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
We've been honing our skills every day 
just to get closer to you, Phalaeno-san! 
Please, take a look!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! The young warriors of our club 
have grown remarkably dependable!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
*Pant, pant*...! 
H-How was that, Phalaeno-san...?!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Right now, you lack the "wisdom" to 
discern 
the critical juncture. You grow far too 
hasty in the middle leg— 
and that applies to every one of you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
You are reaching an age where you must 
begin to think seriously of true races. 
If you leave your weaknesses unaddressed, 
you cannot hope to win your battles.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text: Urgh...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—However. The raw speed of your stride. 
Your stamina. A fighting spirit that never 
waned, even in the final stretch. 
In those, I saw truly remarkable growth.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I have witnessed firsthand the fruits of 
your dedication. 
You did well.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us eat. And while we are at 
it... hehe. 
Why not show me if you've overcome your 
picky eating as well?

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text:
! Leave it to me! I can eat 
asparagus now!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
M-Me too!! I can eat ten whole cups 
of multigrain rice now, 
so just watch me!
choice_data_list:
Now, don't rush, chew your food 
properly...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Savoring your meal and restoring 
your vitality 
is also a runner's duty—do not forget 
that.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
The growth in all of you was truly a sight 
to behold. 
...Hehe. At this rate, I feel as though 
you might overtake me before long.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It pains me to part, but farewell for 
today. 
May you continue to devote yourselves to 
your training.

text_block_list.name: Club Kids
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um...!" "There's one more thing before 
you go!" 
"Something else we want to show you, 
Phalaeno-san!"

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
—"Training day by day, eyes fixed on the 
heights alone, running through each dawn, 
all so that the day will come when we 
follow in her wake"!

And so, each of the club kids shared a 
simple poem, 
expressing their deep respect for 
Phalaenopsis 
and their own heartfelt determinations.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—I see. 
So you too have come to appreciate the art 
of poetry.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
We've been thinking about it all this 
time... 
Wondering what it takes to become 
someone like you, Phalaeno-san.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
We thought, 'We just have to get stronger 
and smarter!'... 
But that alone wasn't enough to reach you.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
And then, we remembered how you would 
sometimes recite such beautiful waka 
poetry, Phalaeno-san.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text:
We realized we need an enriched heart—one 
that can see 
what is remarkable, what is beautiful, and 
what is wonderful 
in everything right before our eyes.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text:
So we all started studying waka together! 
...Though we realized right away just how 
high the bar was.
choice_data_list:
Waka requires a lot of knowledge, after 
all...

Waka does require quite a bit of 
knowledge...

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl C
text_block_list.text:
But just like you taught us, Phalaeno-san, 
a journey of a thousand miles begins with 
a single step!

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
So we decided to start by practicing tanka 
to express what's in our hearts! 
...Even if we're still clumsy at it!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
No—there is nothing clumsy about it. 
Be it waka or tanka, the essence remains 
the same. 
It was a wonderful poem, reflecting a 
truly earnest heart.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...However, if my heart appeared rich to 
you, 
it is not because there is 
anything special within myself.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: It is because all of you dwell within it.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl A
text_block_list.text:
W-We're... 
in your heart, Phalaeno-san?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The source of my strength and 
courage— 
just like family.

text_block_list.name: Horsegirl B
text_block_list.text: ...! Family...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
And... as family, 
there is one piece of advice I can offer 
you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Receive much from your parents, your 
mentors, 
and all those around you—and strive, in 
turn, 
to give back just as much to others.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
That cycle will surely bestow upon you 
more abundance than you could ever 
imagine.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...I was truly caught by surprise today at 
the very end.
choice_data_list: Everyone's striving to be like you.
Everyone looks up to you, you know.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Much as I once looked up to my own 
parents, is that it? ...Hehe.
choice_data_list:
That's just how deeply important you are 
to them.

That's how deeply important you are to 
them, huh.
We drew strength from them as well.

We received strength from them as well, 
didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Much as I once looked up to my own 
parents, is that it? ...Hehe.
choice_data_list:
That's just how deeply important you are 
to them.

That's how deeply important you are to 
them, huh.
We drew strength from them as well.

We received strength from them as well, 
didn't we?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
On equal footing with parents, is it? 
Hehe. They hold me in far too high esteem, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
If that is how they see me— 
I must show them someone worthy of that 
view, 
and fulfill my duty to the fullest.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. ...I truly am blessed 
by those around me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
That song shall become an eternal flame, 
kindled within our hearts.
